channel.title: Easy Footings Product Feed
channel.description: Concrete-free footing systems, adjustable steel stumps and tie downs supplied across Melbourne, Victoria and Australia. Prices include GST.

item.g:title: StumpRite Screw On Adjustable Stump Top
item.g:description: The StumpRite screw-on adjustable stump top threads directly onto SHS steel posts, delivering up to 120mm of fine screw height adjustment for a perfectly level bearer on every stump. No welding is required, installation is fast, and the hot-dip galvanised construction is engineered to Australian standards. Pair it with any StumpRite top plate (straight, vertical, corner, tee or end) to suit your bearer configuration.
item.g:product_type: Footing Systems > StumpRite > Adjustable Stump Tops

item.g:title: StumpRite Weld On Adjustable Stump Top
item.g:description: The StumpRite weld-on adjustable stump top is welded to the top of SHS steel posts and provides up to 120mm of accurate screw height adjustment. It is the economical choice for fabricators and builders who prepare stumps off site, and like every StumpRite component it is Australian made from hot-dip galvanised steel and engineered to Australian standards.
item.g:product_type: Footing Systems > StumpRite > Adjustable Stump Tops

item.g:title: StumpRite Retro Fit Adjustable Stump Top
item.g:description: The StumpRite retro-fit adjustable stump top adds up to 120mm of screw height adjustment to existing steel stumps without replacing the post, making it ideal for restumping, releveling and renovation work across Melbourne and Victoria. Australian made from hot-dip galvanised steel and engineered to Australian standards.
item.g:product_type: Footing Systems > StumpRite > Adjustable Stump Tops

item.g:title: StumpRite Straight Top Plate
item.g:description: The StumpRite straight top plate bolts to any StumpRite adjustable stump top and provides a flat, pre-punched fixing plate for timber or steel bearers running directly over the stump. Hot-dip galvanised and Australian made, it is the most common top plate for new subfloors, decks and extensions.

item.g:title: StumpRite Vertical Top Plate
item.g:description: The StumpRite vertical top plate provides a vertical fixing face for bolting bearers alongside the stump, available in small, large and extra-large sizes to suit different bearer depths. Hot-dip galvanised steel, Australian made and compatible with all StumpRite adjustable stump tops.

item.g:title: StumpRite Corner Top Plate
item.g:description: The StumpRite corner top plate is designed for stumps positioned at corner junctions where two bearers meet, providing pre-punched fixing for both members. Hot-dip galvanised and Australian made, it keeps corner details neat, strong and fully engineered.

item.g:title: StumpRite Tee Top Plate
item.g:description: The StumpRite tee top plate supports tee junctions where an incoming bearer meets a continuous bearer over the stump. Pre-punched for fast fixing, hot-dip galvanised and Australian made to Australian standards.

item.g:title: StumpRite End Top Plate
item.g:description: The StumpRite end top plate is used where a bearer terminates over a stump at the end of a run, with an upstand that captures the bearer end for a secure, engineered connection. Hot-dip galvanised steel, Australian made.

item.g:title: StumpRite Straight Large Top Plate
item.g:description: The StumpRite straight large top plate offers a bigger fixing footprint than the standard straight top, suiting wide bearers, laminated members and steel sections. Hot-dip galvanised and Australian made, compatible with every StumpRite adjustable stump top.

item.g:title: StumpRite 2 Hole Base Plate
item.g:description: The StumpRite 2 hole base plate anchors SHS steel stumps to existing concrete slabs, strip footings or pad footings with two masonry anchors. It is the fast, economical bolt-in base for decks, extensions and restumping. Hot-dip galvanised and Australian made.

item.g:title: StumpRite 4 Hole Base Plate
item.g:description: The StumpRite 4 hole base plate provides a four-anchor connection for steel stumps where higher uplift or lateral loads apply. Bolted to concrete slabs or footings, it delivers a fully engineered hold-down. Hot-dip galvanised and Australian made.

item.g:title: StumpRite Fin Plate Base
item.g:description: The StumpRite fin plate base is cast into wet concrete footings, with a welded fin profile that locks the stump into the concrete for outstanding pull-out and lateral resistance. Hot-dip galvanised and Australian made to Australian standards.

item.g:title: StumpRite Guy Wire Plate
item.g:description: The StumpRite guy wire plate provides engineered anchor points for tensioned guy wires on tall stump installations, sloping sites and high wind areas. Hot-dip galvanised steel, Australian made, and fully compatible with the StumpRite adjustable stump system.

item.g:title: StumpRite Tek Screw Base Plate
item.g:description: The StumpRite tek screw base plate fixes to SHS steel posts with tek screws, removing the need for on-site welding when connecting stumps to bases. Fast to install, hot-dip galvanised and Australian made.

item.g:title: StumpRite Cast In Base Plate
item.g:description: The StumpRite cast-in base plate is the economical way to set SHS steel stumps into poured concrete footings, providing a positive key into the concrete for reliable anchorage. Hot-dip galvanised and Australian made.

item.g:title: StumpRite Cross Bracing
item.g:description: StumpRite cross bracing bolts diagonally below the adjustable stump tops to stiffen steel stump subfloors against lateral and wind loads. It is the engineered bracing solution for taller stumps, sloping blocks and exposed sites. Hot-dip galvanised and Australian made.

item.g:title: StumpRite Galvanised Stair Stringers
item.g:description: StumpRite galvanised steel stair stringers are available in sizes from 1 to 17 treads, giving you an engineered, rot-proof stair structure for decks, raised floors and transportable buildings. Pair them with aluminium or timber tread kits and bolt-down hardware.

item.g:title: SurePile TieDown DHDG
item.g:description: The SurePile TieDown DHDG is a driven ground anchor with a 1000mm lug, supplied with a 1.3m or 3m hot-dip galvanised longlink chain. It is the fully engineered tie-down for shipping containers, transportable buildings, granny flats and relocatable structures, installed in minutes with the SurePile driver.
item.g:product_type: Footing Systems > SurePile > SurePile Tie Downs

item.g:title: SurePile Driver
item.g:description: The SurePile driver is the purpose-built driving tool for installing SurePile tie-down anchors with a standard demolition hammer. One driver installs unlimited anchors, making it a one-off purchase for installers and builders.
item.g:product_type: Footing Systems > SurePile > SurePile Tie Downs
